hot_zone_observations.observation: Throne vision, scroll ingestion, sending/transport, watchman charge and constrained speech are distinguishable movements but remain bound inside the call/commission parent. Ruach, kavod, creature/throne identity, chronology and later reuse remain evidence-only.

Guided stations, marking/execution, chariot recognition, east-gate disputation, sanctuary promise and glory departure form one temple-vision parent. Guide movement supports internal seams; temple theology, figure identity and harmonization do not.
Foundling, accusation/sentence and sisters/covenant movements are visible, yet sexualized allegory and divine-agency ethics cannot be normalized, endorsed or solved by chunking.
The paired-sisters frame, careers, accusation and application stay together. Sexualized violence, agency and ethical pressure remain explicit holds; the unit grants no identity or theology authority.
Forest-fire speech, parable complaint and sword clarification cross the English chapter seam as one interpretive movement. MT/Greek versification pressure selects no preferred numbering or witness.
Command, death/performance, audience response and messenger forecast stay joined as a personal sign-act hinge without resolving grief, violence, divine agency, chronology or ethics.

Addressee resets, dates, qinah labels, because-therefore formulas, catalogues and closures support the nation/ruler units. Old Greek/P967 order and length, ruler identities, history and fulfillment remain deferred.
Messenger arrival, opened mouth, land-claim oracle and hear-not-do coda form a hinge. The fall-report date cannot authorize chronology repair or forced alignment with Kings or Jeremiah.

Mountains, cleansing/heart/ruach, bones, sticks, Gog and gathering/glory movements retain complete forms inside the restoration sequence. P967/Greek order, ruach sense, resurrection, Gog/Rosh/Magog identity and fulfillment remain unresolved.
Continuous inward movement from porch through nave to most holy crosses the chapter seam. Measurements support a station, not a blueprint, ritual prescription or harmonized temple.
Purification, festivals, gates, voluntary offerings and daily offerings form a cross-chapter instruction sequence without authorizing present ritual, calendar, prince identity or temple system.

Date/guide frame, movement, functional spaces, measurements, registers, river, boundaries, allotments and city close support non-chapter units. Every station remains reviewable against the full tour; no temple, land, ritual, eschatology, geography or modern-border authority follows.
